subject: Unit economics follow-up: token volumes, target $/1M tokens, next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery recap — token volumes & budget (FintechX)

Thanks for taking the time today, Alex — quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call.

Key notes from the call:
- Primary use case: in-app personalized financial insights and responses (real-time chat + notifications).
- Expected traffic profile: 10M monthly requests, avg 60 tokens/request (prompt + response) => ~600M tokens/month, spiky during business hours with 3x burst periods.
- Latency SLO: 300ms P95 for chat; some backend batch jobs can tolerate higher latency.
- Data sensitivity: PII in prompts; will need Private deployment or dedicated with encryption & audit logs.

Budget and pricing guardrails you mentioned:
- Initial procurement target: $X-250k annual committed spend (you mentioned a ballpark but said you needed to confirm with procurement).
- Target unit goal: wanting to land at ~$8-12 per 1M tokens (you said you wanted our guidance on realistic targets vs SLAs).

Immediate asks / next steps I recommend:
1) I'll loop in Marcus (SE) with a short unit-econ model for us to validate your 600M/month estimate and show cost / margin scenarios at different $/1M token rates.
2) Please share any historical traffic slices or a CSV with expected daily traffic if you have it (helps with batching/cache modeling).
3) Intro to your procurement contact (procurement@fintechx.com) so we can align on procurement timelines and contract terms.

Deliverables by EOD Mon (Mar 30):
- Redwood unit economics model (spreadsheet) with three scenarios: conservative/expected/aggressive; includes $/1M token inputs, infra mix (hosted vs dedicated), and estimated $/feature for top product flows.
- Proposed pilot scope and SLA options.

Thanks — talk soon.

Thanks for the context. Attached is the initial unit economics model and a short PDF breakdown. Highlights and assumptions below.

High-level highlights:
- Baseline inference cost (hosted, per our curated LLM mix) => $14/1M tokens (expected) without volume discounts or dedicated pricing.
- Dedicated capacity / quantized model path can reduce to ~$6-9/1M tokens depending on instance types, KV cache hit rate, and effective batching.
- For your 600M/month projection: total inference cost range = $3.6k - $8.4k/month (hosted) vs $3.6k - $5.4k/month (dedicated optimized) — see spreadsheet for precise line items. (Note: numbers above are illustrative — full calc in spreadsheet.)

$/feature: example for top 3 features (assumptions: avg tokens per feature, calls/day):
- Personalized insight card (server-rendered, cached prompt prefix): 200 tokens per call => at $10/1M tokens ≈ $0.002 per call; at 2M calls/day that's ~$4k/month in inference cost.
- Real-time chat (session average): 400 tokens per session => $0.004 per session at $10/1M tokens.
- Notification generation (batchable): 50 tokens per notification => $0.0005 per notification.

CAC payback & margin framing:
- If ARPU per new user (first 12 months) is $120 and CAC is $240, you need ~2 years to break even; inference incremental cost at $10/1M tokens with a 10k tokens/user/month profile is ~$0.10/month/user — effectively negligible vs ARPU but material at scale.
- We recommend modeling payback with a 6–18 month window and include inference as an ongoing COGS line tied to MAUs.

Next steps:
- Action: Alex to share traffic sample.
- Action: Marissa to propose pilot scope (we recommend a 3-month pilot on Dedicated with a migration plan).
- Action: Procurement to review SOW + pricing bands (we will attach a draft DocuSign link).

Attachments:
- FintechX_unit_econ_model.xlsx (spreadsheet with scenarios)
- Redwood_unit-cost-breakdown.pdf (2-page summary)

I'll be available for a review at 11am PT Wed — if that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
